citation: Li Y, et al. J Exerc Sci Fit 2024;22:39
protocol: Fasted young men; 60 min treadmill run (09:30-10:30) at the speed eliciting 70% (high) or 40% (low) of VO2max, or rest control; venous blood at 09:30 (pre), 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00 (glucose, insulin; also ghrelin, PYY)
population: 15 healthy young men, 22.7 +/- 1.8 y, BMI 22.2 +/- 2.6, VO2max 56.3 +/- 4.2 mL/kg/min
note: Three-arm crossover (70%, 40%, rest) with glucose and insulin at six times in one table; no lactate, FFA or HR table. Speed set from each runner VO2max.
